title: Height, Balance, and Diameter
statement:
Use a bottom-up tree traversal to compute height, diameter, and height balance. Height and diameter count edges. A tree is balanced if the child subtree heights differ by at most one at every node.

Input
n, then n lines value left right for nodes 1 through n; child ID 0 denotes an absent child.

Output
Print height, diameter, and YES or NO for balance.

Constraints
1 ≤ n ≤ 200000. Values have absolute value at most 10⁹. The child links form one rooted tree with root 1.
